candidates.refactoringInfo: Move method defaultModel to class Select
candidates.description:
Move method defaultModel to org.apache.tapestry5.corelib.components.Select
Rationale: The defaultModel() method is closely related to the Select class as it deals with the creation of a SelectModel based on the type of values that the Select component is expected to handle. Since the Select class is responsible for rendering a select element and managing its options, it makes sense for this method to reside within it. The method's functionality directly pertains to how the Select component operates, particularly in handling Enum types, which are often used in select options.

candidates.refactoringInfo: Move method beginRender to class Field
candidates.description:
Move method beginRender to org.apache.tapestry5.Field
Rationale: The method beginRender(MarkupWriter writer) is closely related to the state of the field, specifically its disabled status. Since the method checks if the field is disabled and then modifies the attributes of the writer accordingly, it logically belongs to the Field class. The Field class is responsible for defining the properties and behavior of form fields, including whether they are disabled. Moving this method to the Field class will enhance cohesion by keeping the rendering logic that pertains to the field's state within the Field class itself.

candidates.refactoringInfo: Move method buildComponentRequestHandler to class TapestryModule
candidates.description:
Move method buildComponentRequestHandler to org.apache.tapestry5.services.TapestryModule
Rationale: The method buildComponentRequestHandler() is closely tied to the TapestryModule class, as it utilizes the pipelineBuilder from TapestryModule to construct a ComponentRequestHandler. This indicates that the method is part of the module's responsibility to manage the request handling pipeline. Moving it to TapestryModule will enhance cohesion, as it will reside in the class that manages the overall configuration and setup of the Tapestry framework.

candidates.refactoringInfo: Move method onActionFromClear to class FormFragmentDemo

candidates.refactoringInfo: Move method toBlock to class BeanBlockOverrideSourceImpl
candidates.description:
Move method toBlock to org.apache.tapestry5.internal.services.BeanBlockOverrideSourceImpl
Rationale: The method 'toBlock' is closely related to the functionality of the 'BeanBlockOverrideSourceImpl' class, as it directly interacts with the 'pageCache' and retrieves a 'Block' based on the 'pageName' and 'blockId'. Moving this method to 'BeanBlockOverrideSourceImpl' enhances cohesion, as it will allow the class to encapsulate all logic related to obtaining blocks from the page cache. Additionally, since the method requires an instance of 'BeanBlockOverrideSourceImpl' to function, it logically fits within this class, improving readability and maintainability.

candidates.refactoringInfo: Move method setBlankOption to class Select
candidates.description:
Move method setBlankOption to org.apache.tapestry5.corelib.components.Select
Rationale: The method setBlankOption(Select select, String label) is directly manipulating the properties blankOption and blankLabel of the Select class. Since these properties are part of the Select class, it is logical for the method to reside within the Select class itself. Moving this method to the Select class will enhance cohesion, as it will encapsulate the behavior related to setting the blank option and its label within the class that manages the select element. This will also improve maintainability and readability, as developers will find all related functionalities in one place.

candidates.refactoringInfo: Move method getTextFieldTranslator to class PropertyEditBlocks

candidates.refactoringInfo: Move method after to class MarkupWriter
candidates.description:
Move method after to org.apache.tapestry5.MarkupWriter
Rationale: The 'after' method is responsible for ending the current element in the markup writing process. Since the 'end()' method is a part of the MarkupWriter interface, it is logical for the 'after' method to reside within this class. Moving it here aligns the method with the functionality of managing the markup structure, ensuring that it is closely associated with the operations that manipulate the current element in the markup stream.

candidates.refactoringInfo: Move method begin to class ValidationTracker
candidates.description:
Move method begin to org.apache.tapestry5.ValidationTracker
Rationale: The 'begin' method is responsible for rendering a checkbox input based on user input, which is directly related to tracking user input validations. The method retrieves the input value using 'tracker.getInput(this)', indicating that it relies on the functionality provided by the ValidationTracker interface. Moving this method to ValidationTracker would encapsulate the rendering logic with the input tracking logic, making the code more cohesive and easier to maintain.

candidates.refactoringInfo: Move method failIfNotFrozen to class InternalClassTransformationImpl

Moving it here enhances encapsulation and maintains the principle of locality, as the method's functionality is closely tied to the state of the InternalClassTransformationImpl instance.

candidates.refactoringInfo: Move method onSuccess to class Upcase
candidates.description:
Move method onSuccess to org.example.testapp.services.Upcase
Rationale: The method onSuccess(Start start) is responsible for transforming the input string to uppercase using the upcaseBean. Since upcaseBean is an instance of the Upcase interface, it is more appropriate for the onSuccess method to reside within the Upcase class. This change will enhance the cohesion of the code by placing the string transformation logic closer to the functionality it utilizes, thereby adhering to the Single Responsibility Principle. Additionally, it will make the Upcase class more versatile, allowing it to handle various input strings without being tightly coupled to the Start class.

candidates.refactoringInfo: Move method setupRender to class FormSupport

This class manages form-related actions and interactions, making it the most appropriate place for this method. Moving it here will enhance cohesion, as the method directly interacts with form components and their lifecycle.

candidates.refactoringInfo: Move method cleanupRender to class FormSupport
candidates.description:
Move method cleanupRender to org.apache.tapestry5.services.FormSupport
Rationale: The method cleanupRender() is responsible for executing a cleanup action related to rendering, which aligns closely with the responsibilities of the FormSupport class. candidates.refactoringInfo: Move method cleanupEnvironment to class ComponentResources
candidates.description:
Move method cleanupEnvironment to org.apache.tapestry5.ComponentResources
Rationale: The cleanupEnvironment() method is responsible for managing the environment stack, specifically popping the BeanEditContext. This operation is closely related to the lifecycle and resource management of components, which is a core responsibility of the ComponentResources class. Moving this method to ComponentResources aligns it with the component's lifecycle management, ensuring that environment cleanup is handled in the context of component resource management.

candidates.refactoringInfo: Move method onActionFromClear to class FormSupport
candidates.description:
Move method onActionFromClear to org.apache.tapestry5.services.FormSupport
Rationale: The method onActionFromClear() is responsible for clearing data and form errors, which directly relates to the functionality of form handling. The FormSupport interface provides services for form elements, including error management and control name allocation. Since the method's purpose is to manipulate the form's state (clearing errors and data), it aligns more closely with the responsibilities of FormSupport than with BeanEditorBeanEditContext, which is more focused on managing the bean's state rather than the form's behavior.

candidates.refactoringInfo: Move method doPrepare to class Environment
candidates.description:
Move method doPrepare to org.apache.tapestry5.services.Environment
Rationale: The doPrepare() method is responsible for initializing the model and managing the BeanEditContext within the environment. Since it interacts directly with the environment by pushing the BeanEditContext onto the environment stack, it is more appropriate for this method to reside in the Environment class. This move will enhance the cohesion of the Environment class, as it will encapsulate the logic related to managing environmental contexts, making it easier to maintain and understand.
